[{"type":"GeneralText","content":"
  • See the Professional & Continuing Education website for more information about this program and to start the application process.
  • See the University Catalog for prerequisite information and upper division program requirements.
  • See the Admissions website for transfer admission requirements/information.
  • See the International Education & Global Engagement website for international transfer academic qualifications.
  • See the Academic Advising Programs website for information on California Promise and Associate Degree for Transfer.
  • See the University Catalog for Credit by Exam information (AP, IB, CLEP).


Online degree completion students who have completed their General Education and American Ideals/Institutions requirements before transferring to Chico State and who enroll in classes full time can easily finish their BA in social science in two years. Note that some online courses are offered only once a year, so careful planning is crucial. All students must meet with a Social Science advisor each semester for mandatory advising.

","groupId":"cfb36845-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CONCENTRATION REQUIREMENT: AREAS OF CONCENTRATION","groupId":"d9b36845-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Areas of Concentration (Group 2-7): Students are required to select one of the 7 areas of concentration listed below. They must take 21 units (up to 9 units at the lower division level and 12 units REQUIRED at the upper division level) from one of the following concentrations to complete this requirement. It is highly recommended students reference the University Catalog to see the full listing of degree requirements.

  • Anthropology: Six units available at the lower division level.
  • Career and Life Planning: Three units available at the lower division level.
  • Child Development: Carefully select courses to ensure the area of concentration upper division unit requirement is met. Nine units available at the lower division level.
  • Community Organizing for Social Change: Only upper division courses in this area of concentration, none at the lower division level (no course listings below).
  • Environmental Planning: Three units available at the lower division level.
  • Family Relations: Nine units available at the lower division level.
  • Gerontology: Three units available at the lower division level.
